target: Teach another learner to reason about grounded dialogue using an evidence-cited dialogue response. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Teach grounded dialogue — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about grounded dialogue using an evidence-cited dialogue response. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: citing a source that does not support the claim

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in an evidence-cited dialogue response.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report claim support and appropriate abstention with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: citing a source that does not support the claim.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of grounded dialogue.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report claim support and appropriate abstention against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for citing a source that does not support the claim; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
